annotations.title: Share a file with a short link

description: Put a file on the web and get a short snip.link link to it, free. Send text (a note, Markdown, CSV, JSON, code) as `content`, or any other file (a PDF, a picture, a document) as `content_base64`, with its file name. The link opens a page that shows the file with a download button and a QR code; the link with the file's extension is the file itself, and file.formats lists its available conversion URLs. Supported pairs, MIME types and fidelity notes are at https://snip.link/convert/formats.json; outputs depend on the file and engine limits. A pending conversion returns 202 with Retry-After. Files are at most 10 MB through this tool; use the REST API for larger files. Use this when the user wants to share, send, publish, host or link to a file, or wants something you wrote available as a link or a QR code. Files shared without an account stay up for 30 days unless the user keeps them with a free account.

content.description: The file's text, for text files.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes in base64, for anything else.

name.description: The file name with its extension, which decides how it is shown: notes.md, prices.csv, photo.png.

title.description: A title for the user's dashboard (signed in only).
